scope: Consequential c01_l03, c01_l06 and c01_l09 claims compared against all three frozen c01 Sol INITIALs and the supplied cycle4/5 baseline. Peer outputs are untrusted until reconstructed. Scores indicate contribution within this round, not model causation, priority or external validation.

claims.exact_claim: For supported ordinary rank-r column bases A,B and a in A\B, with d=|B\A|, |det V_A det V_B|^2 <= d sum_b |det V_(A-a+b) det V_(B-b+a)|^2; common cores, complex phases and zero exchanged minors are allowed.
claims.baseline_overlap: Classical Grassmann-Pluecker identity and Cauchy-Schwarz, complementary to the frozen Sol exact contraction algorithms. The supplied baseline already distinguishes ordinary volume sampling from pair-closed parity sampling. This is not a new parity stability or energy theorem.
claims.independent_review: Alternating cofactor dependence wedged with A-a gives exactly the stated d-term identity; common-core terms vanish. The argument is complete and correct. Own exact diagnostics cover 3,540 supported pivot instances on six complex integer matrices.
claims.source_dependencies: No external load-bearing theorem beyond elementary determinant multilinearity; priority of Pluecker algebra is classical.
claims.cost: O(r) ordinary determinant products, each polynomial-bit. Pair closure is generally lost. No legal paired transition, connectivity, congestion or normalizer follows.
claims.score_reason: Useful operational exchange diagnostic; classical ordinary-basis algebra, no assigned microscopic gate acquired.

claims.exact_claim: For the symmetric proposal choosing a and then b uniformly among the ordinary basis differences, the acceptance averaged over b conditional on a is at least d^-2.
claims.baseline_overlap: Pointwise consequence of the preceding ordinary exchange; does not strengthen the frozen Sol full-refresh kernels or remove c01_s02's paired-move obstruction.
claims.independent_review: Writing destination/source product ratios r_b gives sum r_b>=1/d. Since sum min(1,r_b)>=min(1,sum r_b)>=1/d, division by d proves the claim. The reverse pivot is b; the full a,b-uniform proposal is symmetric. Exact own acceptance tests passed.
repairs: Keep the full symmetric pivot proposal explicit; fixing one pivot globally is not the same reversible kernel.
claims.cost: O(r) polynomial-bit weight ratios; invariant multiset union and split-pair destinations remain. Global gap UNKNOWN.
claims.score_reason: Local acceptance cannot be promoted to parity mixing.

claims.exact_claim: Directed 2q cycle has only two alternating pair-closed bases. All proper sub-q pair replacements have zero product weight, while one ordinary Pluecker term swaps identical coordinate copies and has weight one. A 2q-step ordinary cross-swap path preserves determinant modulus one and requires up to 2q split labels.
claims.baseline_overlap: The two-support cycle and bounded paired-move disconnection are already in cycle4/5 and the frozen c01_s01/s02 INITIALs. The flat ordinary split path clarifies a distinct legal enlarged-state interface but does not furnish its target measure.
claims.independent_review: Cycle support condition sigma(I)=I^c forces alternation. The unique nonzero exchange of e_0 is its labelled duplicate f_(n-1). Swapping each coordinate duplicate once gives the stated path; every original column must cross replica, giving the length lower bound.
claims.cost: 2q polynomial point-weight steps on the special permutation family. Arbitrary-F path congestion and exact-marginal repair UNKNOWN.
claims.score_reason: Cycle obstruction itself is duplicate; the explicit flat split route is a useful diagnostic.

claims.exact_claim: For q independent swap blocks, ordinary volume partition is 4^q, paired partition 2^q, each of 2^q supported split characters has mass 2^q. Diagonal-character projection retains only 2^-q of independent tensor norm; conditioned target empty-character pair also has mass 2^-q within that diagonal fiber.
claims.baseline_overlap: Exponential common-orientation and soft-event losses are in the supplied baseline. This gives an explicit character-register explanation; it is not a general obstruction to weighted or endpoint-tagged lifts.
claims.independent_review: Each two-site block has four ordinary coordinate bases: two pair-closed and two with both site labels split, all of weight one. Tensor products give every displayed count. Equal-character tensor norm is sum_chi Z_chi^2; the formulas follow directly. Union-preserving cross-swaps conserve character difference.
claims.source_dependencies: Cauchy-Binet and direct finite-group character orthogonality. No connectivity theorem is imported.
claims.cost: Closed-form family; general lift normalization/mixing costs UNKNOWN.
claims.score_reason: Useful duplicate-boundary diagnostic, no exact-marginal lift acquired.

claims.exact_claim: Uniform all-a,b additive gate with constant L, common symmetric MH proposal, adjacent density ratios in [1/2,2], common support and exact base refresh imply a replicated-product lazy gap at least 3/(8M), with q=ceil(32L), M=Tq^2+q.
claims.baseline_overlap: Reconstruction of the pinned OA113/L07 ordered-product ANOVA proof already supplied in the baseline and explicitly used by frozen c01_s01. c01_s03's acquired full-refresh energy satisfies a subclass gate, while c01_s02 supplies a move-class failure. No determinant-specific local inequality is added.
claims.independent_review: Capacity comparison gives the factor 1/2. Jensen and E(r)<=2||r||^2 yield ||h_x||^2<=4L E_xy(f)+8L||r_xy||^2. Every ANOVA interaction appearing in a residual has a unique last-two-coordinate pair, so residual norms sum at most Var(f). q>=32L absorbs the residual; lazy mixture scaling yields the stated gap.
repairs: Use integral q=ceil(32 max(L,1)); this preserves every inequality and avoids a nonintegral replica count.
claims.source_dependencies: Pinned OA113 source at adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a; local work/cycle1/combinatorics_oa113.tex. Imported graph-matching gate is not a determinant theorem.
claims.cost: q(T+1) slots, M updates, mixing O(M[Lambda+log(1/sigma)]) times acquired transition cost. Actual determinant L and computable kernel UNKNOWN.
claims.score_reason: Correct baseline reconstruction; required determinant premise remains open.

claims.exact_claim: A b=0 comparison can hold while a+b has zero energy; an all-a,b comparison can hold while the full pair gap is zero; gap-one endpoint refreshes can have exponential direct importance variance.
claims.baseline_overlap: The arbitrary-f1,f2 distinction is explicit in frozen c01_s02 and the supplied OA113 proof; frozen c01_s01 refreshes only one replica and correctly avoids claiming a full pair gap. The exact binary witnesses make those quantifiers concrete.
claims.independent_review: For theta(x,y)=(1-y,1-x), a=x,b=-y is invariant while b=0 energy equals Var(a). XOR-conditional heatbath has additive energy Var(a)+Var(b) yet preserves XOR. Swapped endpoint Bernoulli laws have variance (1-2epsilon)^2/[epsilon(1-epsilon)]. Own exact binary checks covered 625 arbitrary function assignments and both relevant additive inequalities.
claims.source_dependencies: Direct finite rational calculations; no determinant theorem.
claims.cost: Constant-size diagnostics; they do not supply a kernel or an annealing path.
claims.score_reason: Useful precise witnesses for requirements already in the baseline.

claims.exact_claim: For the PSD additive energy block [[A,B],[B*,C]], the all-a,b gate is equivalent to A-BC^dagger B*>=L^-1 I. Marginal coercivity lambda and whitened cross-correlation rho<1 suffice for L<=1/[(1-rho)lambda].
claims.baseline_overlap: A reusable operator diagnostic absent explicitly from the three frozen Sol INITIALs, though pseudoinverse Schur complements are standard linear algebra. It does not acquire an operator bound for an exponentially large determinant kernel.
claims.independent_review: Positivity forces B ker C=0, hence B*a lies in range C. Completing the square gives the exact infimum over b and the equivalence. The correlation inequality yields the claimed looser bound.
repairs: A sharper sufficient bound follows from A+C-2rho sqrt(AC)=(sqrt(C)-rho sqrt(A))^2+(1-rho^2)A: L<=1/[(1-rho^2)lambda]. This is an elementary strengthening, not a determinant application.
claims.source_dependencies: Elementary PSD block-form and pseudoinverse algebra; source priority for this standard criterion is not claimed.
claims.cost: Worst-case lambda/rho computation on the actual determinant kernel UNKNOWN; operator dimensions can be exponential.
claims.score_reason: Reusable exact gate diagnostic, with no algorithmic gate closure.

claims.exact_claim: Polynomial-bit nonzero determinant weights give polynomial log minimum mass. With factor-2 adjacent overlap, independent product-of-stage-means estimation costs O(T^2 epsilon^-2 log(1/delta)) independent samples, before mixing/bit simulation.
claims.baseline_overlap: Standard rational-height and importance-product accounting; clarifies supplied graph-annealing template without improving frozen Sol tractable structural samplers.
claims.independent_review: Common-denominator nonzero determinant magnitude is at least D^-d; Hadamard and at most 2^m bases give the stated log-mass bound. A stage mean from s samples has relative variance<=1/s; independent stages give product variance <=(1+1/s)^T-1. Taking s=Theta(T epsilon^-2) and median amplification yields the final O(T^2) count.
repairs: The INITIAL's abbreviated O(T epsilon^-2 log(T/delta)) independent-sample scale is not the end-to-end total; FINAL corrects it to O(T^2 epsilon^-2 log(1/delta)). Correlated states require additional justification.
claims.source_dependencies: Standard determinant height, importance sampling, Chebyshev/median amplification; exact base refresh and actual L remain hypotheses.
claims.cost: O(T^2 epsilon^-2 log(1/delta)) fresh samples times warm-start-free mixing and transition costs; backend cost UNKNOWN.
claims.score_reason: Useful cost repair, not a new determinant sampler.

claims.origin: work/cycle6/c01_l09/INITIAL.txt section 4 and revisions/r1_balance_vs_soft_overlap.txt section A
claims.exact_claim: If all two-hole ratios a_ij>0 are supplied, there exist theta_i>0 with max_j theta_i theta_j a_ij=1 for every i, implemented by law-preserving DFD congruence and corresponding coordinate-auxiliary scaling.
claims.baseline_overlap: The baseline capacity theorem assumes hole balance; the frozen c01_s02 family is already balanced and its bad union-preserving ratio survives all such gauges. This existence normal form cannot repair that obstruction or acquire unknown hole ratios.
claims.independent_review: Maximize sum_i y_i subject to y_i+y_j<=-log a_ij. The source's individual-coordinate bound is false: a_ij=1 and y=(M,-M,-M) give feasible y_1 arbitrarily large. Nevertheless summing all pair constraints yields (n-1)sum_i y_i<=-sum_(i<j)log a_ij. Feasibility and bounded linear objective on a polyhedron imply an attained optimum. Each i must have a tight incident edge, or y_i can increase. theta_i=exp y_i proves the conclusion. For n=2, choose y_1+y_2=-log a_12. Complementary minors scale by product_(r in R)D_rr, preserving the full normalized law.
repairs: Replace the invalid coordinate-bound paragraph in BOTH INITIAL and R1 by the summed-objective bound. INITIAL must remain immutable; record the correction in a revision.
claims.source_dependencies: Elementary finite LP attainment; exact ratio values are an oracle/interface assumption. Logs and algebraic scale representation do not provide those values. Priority UNKNOWN.
claims.cost: Existence if exact a_ij are supplied. Polynomial acquisition of all a_ij for unrestricted full parity sector UNKNOWN; exact matrix representation can involve algebraic scalings rather than rational F.
claims.score_reason: Reusable conditional normal-form lemma with a repaired proof; acquisition remains open.

claims.exact_claim: For rational orthogonal six-site F=[[cP,-sP],[sP,cP]], ordinary size-six DPP with split penalty epsilon has every column marginal 1/2, yet hard event probability 2b/[a(6epsilon+2epsilon^3)^2+b((1+epsilon)^6+(epsilon-1)^6)] is Theta(2^-2L) at fixed epsilon and s~2^(1-L).
claims.baseline_overlap: The baseline already warns that soft paired events can be exponentially rare; frozen c01_s02's balanced hole ratios also fail to control a microscopic move. This fixture distinguishes ordinary column-marginal calibration from hole-ratio balance and retains condition number one.
claims.independent_review: Own polynomial determinant expansion of all 924 ordinary bases verifies the closed partition formula symbolically modulo c^2+s^2=1, not just at one decimal fixture. At u=1/4096, epsilon=1/64 the exact hard probability matches 0.00016270737334387082 and all twelve marginals are exactly 1/2. Complement symmetry plus orthogonality gives the universal marginal statement. Expanding b=3s^2+O(s^4) and denominator=36epsilon^2+O(epsilon^4)+O(s^2) proves the fixed-epsilon asymptotic order.
repairs: The leading coefficient s^2/(6epsilon^2) is an additional small-epsilon approximation; at fixed epsilon the exact leading coefficient is 6s^2/(6epsilon+2epsilon^3)^2. Theta(s^2) and the exponential sample lower bound remain correct.
claims.source_dependencies: Direct determinant polynomial expansion, orthogonal-frame complementary minor identity and Bernoulli variance. No unrestricted hardness transfer.
claims.cost: IID hard-indicator relative variance=(1-p)/(m p), so constant-error sample cost Omega(p^-1) in this specified estimator. Different importance/global samplers are not excluded.
claims.score_reason: Reusable calibrated-marginal counterexample; broad soft-rarity conclusion overlaps baseline.
